text:
Sam Park: Need a focused launch asset pack for the benchmark webinar next week. Ask: 1) animated microtile hero (Lottie + GIF fallback) for landing, 2) four social crops (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, story), 3) email hero + two mobile headers, 4) a single-page infographic (800x600) that visualizes inbound routing webinar -> signup -> demo -> trial and surfaces optional stat callouts, 5) a downloadable sales one-pager PDF (1280x720) and 6) an export manifest with filenames, alt text, and export sizes. Accessibility + dark-mode required. Deadline: next Mon 5pm PT.

Imani Ruiz: Cool. For the microtile hero: SVG/Lottie for web, GIF for email. Motion constraints? reduced-motion version required. Also what dimensions for hero and tiles?

Sam Park: Hero Lottie: 1400x560. Email GIF fallback: 800x300. Social crops: 1200x1200, 1600x900, 1080x1920, 1080x1920 story frame with CTA-safe zone. Infographic: 800x600 PNG + SVG. Sales PDF: 1280x720. Export PNGs at 2x for retina.

Jonah Blake: On the infographic: sales wants these toggles as separate layers in the SVG: Hosted / Dedicated / Private nodes, and optional stat callouts (median latency in ms, $ per 1k tokens). Make stat callouts small and low-ink by default so the diagram reads without them. Also provide a version with callouts on.

Product PR: We'll need 3 short copy hooks and 2 CTA variants for A/B. Also include UTM-ready CTA links for email and social. I'll drop the copy by EOD today.

Brand Review: Brand constraints: use palette v3 tokens only. Headline font = Inter Display, body = Inter. Do not use neon pinks or unapproved accents. Body text contrast >= 4.5:1; large text >= 3:1. Provide alt text drafts for each asset and captions for animated versions. Include color token names in Figma layers.

Imani Ruiz: Noted. I'll produce a motion-safe static PNG, a dark-mode set, and color-token-labeled Figma file. Also suggest microtile animation loop <=5s, avoid strobing.

DesignOps Bot: Design slot assigned: Imani Tue 10am PT (2 hours). If you need priority, request override. I'll auto-generate an export checklist with required filenames and sizes.

Jonah Blake: Filing note: please name assets like: microtile-hero-web-1400x560-v1.json (for Lottie) / microtile-hero-email-800x300-v1.gif / infographic-800x600-v1.svg / sales-onepager-1280x720-v1.pdf. Include manifest.json in the Figma file with alt_text fields.

Product PR: Copy hooks coming: "Benchmark the real tradeoffs"; "Inference: faster for less"; "See latency vs cost in action." CTAs: "Register" / "Request demo". Will add alt text snippets and short CTA URLs with UTM params.

Sam Park: Great. Priorities: clarity for sales reuse, accessible defaults, and tidy export manifest. If there are tradeoffs (animation vs accessibility or dark-mode contrast), call them out in Figma comments. Locking deadline: Mon 5pm PT unless we escalate. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
